turns.question: What was our refund rate by value on the orders placed on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no refund-rate-by-value metric, so I can't give that figure. The closest metrics are Return rate (the share of orders returned, counted by number of orders) and Returns (EUR) (the sum of partner return amounts, not a rate); I did not compute either for 1 and 2 October.
